AxTableField.Name: CertificateString
AxTableField.Label: Certificate
AxTableField.HelpText: The WMSCERT1... certificate string the vendor issued during onboarding, signed with the vendor's root key and carrying this environment's own customer public key. Paste it here together with a matching license string - see licensing/README.md. A pair that does not verify together is refused on save, not silently accepted.

AxTableField.Name: LicenseKey
AxTableField.Label: License key
AxTableField.HelpText: The WMSLIC1... signed license string provided by the vendor - pasted together with a matching certificate above. Encodes its own expiry date and device limit; nothing here can change what it grants without a new signed key. A pair that does not verify together is refused on save, not silently accepted.

AxTableField.Name: AzureFunctionUrl
AxTableField.Label: License status check URL
AxTableField.HelpText: The vendor CheckLicense Azure Function endpoint - see azure-license-function/README.md. Not sensitive on its own (it is just a URL), kept in the open alongside the key below.

AxTableField.Name: AzureFunctionKey
AxTableField.Label: License status check key
AxTableField.HelpText: The Function own access key. Stored encrypted at rest - see encryptFunctionKeyIfNeeded()/decryptFunctionKey() below - so a browse of this table shows ciphertext, not a usable key: this key is vendor infrastructure a customer own admin should never be able to extract and call directly.
